Run the full DeepSeek Harness in Linux on this phone to get plugin installs, real bash, git, Python, and Node. Android 16 includes a Linux Terminal (Settings, then Developer options, then Linux development environment). The app shows the engine instead of the lighter on-device mode.
1. In the Linux Terminal, run these commands once. The last line starts the engine; next time, run only that line. The first install downloads a few hundred megabytes.
2. When the terminal prints a link starting with http://127.0.0.1:47400/?token=, copy it and paste it here. If the terminal asks to allow port 47400, allow it.
Nothing answers at that link. Make sure dsh web is still running in the terminal and port 47400 is allowed.
